question: I was charged twice for the same month. What counts as a duplicate and what happens next?
reply:
A duplicate charge is defined as two charges on the same account for the same plan and billing period posted within 72 hours of each other.
Regarding what happens next:
A confirmed duplicate charge is escalated to the billing team for review.Support never promises a refund during the investigation.Billing reviews are normally decided within 5 business days, and refund processing (where approved) happens in the billing system, which may take additional days to appear with your bank.
